symptom: On macOS the app in the downloaded DMG fails code signature checks and may refuse to open.
toml:
known_fixed = ["lightcraft"]
references = ["storytold/lightcraft#959"]
title = "Build the macOS DMG with hdiutil create -srcfolder instead of makehybrid"
why = "`hdiutil makehybrid -hfs` adds FinderInfo extended attributes to the already signed app while it builds the image. Because of that, the app inside the downloaded DMG fails strict code-signature checks, and Gatekeeper may refuse to open it."

[[applies_if]]
grep = "^[^#]*hdiutil"
in = ["packaging/**"]

[exempt]

[[fixed_if]]
grep = "^[^#]*-srcfolder"
in = ["packaging/**"]

[[proof]]
app = "lightcraft"
pr = 959
reasoning: The fix that every app shares is dropping `hdiutil makehybrid` + convert and building the image with `hdiutil create -srcfolder`, which leaves the signed bundle unchanged. Before the fix, `-srcfolder` showed up only in a shell comment ("unlike `create -srcfolder`"). The pattern `^[^#]*-srcfolder` skips comment lines, so it fails before the fix and passes after it. It still matches if a port puts the flag on a backslash-continued line, wraps hdiutil in a retry helper, or orders the arguments differently. I left out the `xattr -cr` and mounted-image verification steps as required markers: only one diff was shown, and other apps may have done those parts differently or already had them. applies_if limits the check to apps whose packaging scripts actually call hdiutil.

cadcraft.evidence:
packaging/macos/package.sh:
hdiutil makehybrid -hfs -hfs-volume-name "CADCraft" -hfs-openfolder "$STAGE" -o "$WORK/raw.dmg" "$STAGE"
hdiutil convert "$WORK/raw.dmg" -format UDZO -imagekey zlib-level=9 -o "$DMG"
...
sign "$DMG"
codesign --verify --strict --verbose=2 "$DMG"
(no `xattr -cr "$APP"` before signing, and the app inside the finished DMG is never verified)
cadcraft.explanation: CADCraft's package.sh is the same as the sibling's script before the fix. It signs CADCraft.app, copies it into the stage folder with ditto, and builds the DMG with `hdiutil makehybrid -hfs`. That command adds FinderInfo extended attributes to the signed app. Nothing protects against this: the script doesn't clear xattrs before signing, doesn't use `create -srcfolder`, and only verifies the DMG container's signature, never the app inside the finished image. The dmg/README.md also says the DMG is built with `hdiutil makehybrid`.

craft-launcher.evidence:
packaging/macos/package.sh:
hdiutil makehybrid -hfs -hfs-volume-name "$APP_NAME $VERSION" -hfs-openfolder "$STAGE" -o "$WORK/raw.dmg" "$STAGE"
hdiutil convert "$WORK/raw.dmg" -format UDZO -imagekey zlib-level=9 -o "$DMG"

packaging/macos/verify.sh:
# Integrity first: ... Not --strict here: files read back from
# the DMG's HFS volume (hdiutil makehybrid) report a com.apple.FinderInfo attribute, which strict
# mode calls "detritus".
codesign --verify --deep --verbose=2 "$APP"
craft-launcher.explanation: The app still builds its DMG with `hdiutil makehybrid -hfs` and then `convert`, which is the same approach the sibling had before its fix. It has none of the fix's parts: no `xattr -cr` before signing, no `create -srcfolder`, and no strict check of the app inside the finished DMG. verify.sh even says that the app in the DMG gets com.apple.FinderInfo detritus. Instead of fixing that, it turns off `--strict` to work around it. So the shipped app fails strict signature checks, which is exactly this bug.

effectcraft.explanation: EffectCraft builds its DMG the same way the sibling did before its fix. It copies the signed (and possibly stapled) EffectCraft.app into the staging folder, then runs `hdiutil makehybrid -hfs` and `hdiutil convert`. gridcraft.explanation:
GridCraft still builds its DMG the way the sibling did before its fix. It runs `hdiutil makehybrid -hfs` on a staging folder that holds the already signed GridCraft.app, then converts the result to UDZO. makehybrid adds FinderInfo extended attributes to the signed bundle, so the app inside the image can fail strict codesign checks and Gatekeeper.

The script also lacks the other parts of the sibling's fix:
- It never clears extended attributes before signing.
- It never mounts the finished DMG to verify the app inside it. It only runs `codesign --verify` on the DMG container.

The dmg/README.md says outright that the DMG "still builds with `hdiutil makehybrid`".
